rv.q: This glorious and timeless Jerry Bock/Sheldon Harnick musical classic is flawlessly acted and beautifully sung in Matthew Silar's polished professional production.
This is just the beginning of a beautiful production that weaves a spell around the beloved musical, She Loves Me, written by Jerry Bock and Sheldon Harnick a year before Fiddler on the Roof.
You will walk out of the theater feeling satisfied with your experience and wanting to say to the cast and crew, "Thank you, thank you , I 'll come again- Thank you!".

Because the musical by composer Jerry Bock and lyricist Sheldon Harnick , with a book by Joe Masteroff and based on the 1937. Hungarian play Parfumerie by Miklos Laszlo , really is charming. And as sweet and light as a whipped cream confection.

The show is a Jerry Bock/Sheldon Harnick, Joe Masteroff muscial with award-winning revivals that started out in 1937 as “Perfumerie" by Hungarian playwright Miklos Laszlo. It went on to become the film "The Shop Around the Corner" in 1940 then redone as "In the Good Old Summertime."
